Hi Amelia / John —

Thanks for sending the executed PO and the draft order form. I pulled the attachments into our contracting queue and did a quick scan. Before we route formal redlines, two ask areas we need to confirm so Legal can prioritize: 

1) Template parity: please confirm whether you intend to take our standard MSA (attached) or use counterparty edits to our template. If you prefer yours, can you confirm which clauses you expect to keep (liability, indemnities, termination, export controls)? That helps us scope redlines.

2) Data residency / residency addendum: you flagged EU-only processing in the last call. We don’t have an existing exhibit capturing residency carveouts for your account. For compliance we typically either: (a) add an Exhibit B with region-specific residency language + approved sub-processors; or (b) accept a short addendum limited to data at rest/location. Can you confirm Cloudhaven's requirement (processing location vs. data-at-rest), and whether you need contractual commitments about residency or just technical controls?

Deliverables we will produce after confirmation:
- Initial redline pass (tracked) on the MSA + Order Form
- Draft residency addendum for your review (if required)
- List of requested evidence from Security (SOC2 scope, subprocessor list)

I attached the OrderForm you sent, a copy of our standard MSA for parity reference, and a short draft residency addendum template that we typically start from.

Proposed next steps:
- Please reply with the residency preference and whether you'll use your template or ours by end of day tomorrow (Fri).
- If you already have outside counsel reviewing, loop them in and we’ll coordinate a single redline pass.

Want to sync live? I can set a 30-min slot early next week to resolve carveouts quickly.

Thanks —
Sofia

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers:
- Residency: Cloudhaven requires EU-only processing for customer content and a contractual commitment that customer data at rest will not be stored outside the EU without prior written consent. We also need visibility into sub-processors and a right to approve changes.
- Template: we intend to start from our preferred MSA (attached) and I’ve included our counsel Kathryn on this thread. We redlined a handful of commercial points; attached is a first-pass with comments (redlines_cloudhaven_amelia_v1.docx).

Two clarifying Qs for Redwood Legal: 
1) For the EU-only processing commitment, do you have a standard Exhibit or limited addendum you prefer? If so, please share a draft we can comment on.
2) On liability cap language: we redlined Section 7 (limit to fees paid in prior 12 months). Is Redwood open to a carveout for data protection negligence?

We can do a live call Monday 9–11 PT or Tuesday 1–3 PT.

Best —
